ashley (platform): Heads up — proposal to canonicalize route keys and split quota_profile into its own table. Goal: simplify dashboard joins + make per-tenant quota lookups O(1).

 dan (eng): +1. What's the plan for existing dashboards and saved queries? A lot use route_tags blob today.

 ashley (platform): We'll introduce `route_canonical` and `quota_profile` tables, then dual-write from ingest for 2 weeks, followed by readswitch with feature flag. Dashboards will use an adaptor layer to map old blob keys to canonical ids.

 priya (product): Concern: how do we avoid transient metric gaps during read switch? Product dashboards are business-critical for ops.

 miguel (sre): Canary idea: enable readswitch for 5% of routes and compare aggregates. Also run a consistency auditor job that scans a sample and reports mismatches. If mismatch rate >0.5% rollback.

 ashley (platform): SQL sketch:
```
ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN canonical_id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();
CREATE TABLE quota_profile (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id uuid, profile jsonb);
-- dual-write: ingest service writes both routes.route_key and route_canonical.canonical_id
```

 dan (eng): Indexing plan? Reads are high-volume by canonical_id and time window.

 ashley (platform): We'll add a composite index on (canonical_id, day) for metrics projection. Also keep route_key->canonical_id in a small in-memory cache on query side.

 priya (product): UX for rollout — can we expose a flag in the console per-tenant to opt into the new mapping? Helps support teams debug issues.

 ashley (platform): Yes — adding per-tenant toggle in console, default off. We'll start with internal tenants, then customers who opt in.

 migration-bot: Migration job scheduled: `route-canonical-backfill` starts 2024-06-10T02:00Z, parallelism=8. Monitor at /observability/migrations/route-canonical.

 miguel (sre): Make sure backfill throttles by ingestion QPS; we don't want to blow up downstream metrics pipelines.

 dan (eng): Also add a read-adaptor in console that falls back to parsing route_tags when canonical_id missing. Minimizes outages.

 ashley (platform): Action items: (1) PR for schema + indexes (dan), (2) dual-write in ingest svc (ashley), (3) console adaptor + tenant toggle (priya), (4) auditor job + runbook (miguel). I'll open tasks.

 priya (product): Sounds good. Please post roll-out playbook in this thread once PRs land. :thumbsup:

 ashley (platform): Will do — thanks all.
